title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 133
paragraphs: Not long after this another thing came to pass. Atossa, daughter of Cyrus and wife of Darius, had a tumour on her breast, which afterwards burst and began to spread further. So long as it was not large, she concealed it and told no one, because she was ashamed. But afterwards, when she was in a bad state, she sent for Demokedes and showed it to him. He said he would cure her, and made her swear that she would surely do in return whatever he asked of her; and he would ask, he said, nothing shameful.
